textbookText: A. Tick the correct alternative. 1. A young one of fish starts swimming after emerging from egg. What type of behaviour is this? a. learnt behaviour b. innate behaviour c. Acquired behaviour d. Migratory behaviour 2. The organs which perceive stimulus are called……… a. receptors b. effectors c. Glands d. muscles 3. Which of the following events is not the example of reflex action? a. blinking eye b. Reading c. Coughing d. hiccuping 4. Toad is active at night time, this is the example of ………………… a. positive phototaxis b. positive chemotaxis c. negative phototaxis d. positive geotaxis 5. Male cockroach is attracted by the pheromones emitted by female cockroach at the time of mating. This is the example of……………. a. phototaxis b. rheotaxis c. Chemotaxis d. Geotaxis 6. Migration of fishes which is only take place in fresh water is called……. a. catadromous b. amphidromous c. oceanodromous d. potadromous 7. During rainy season, there are floods and strong water currents in river and streams. Fishes seek and move to smaller side channel with less current, water bottom or hide under rock. Which type of taxis is this? a. geotaxis b. klinotaxis c. tropotaxis d. rheotaxis
8. Moles live underground. Which type of taxis is this? a. Chemotaxis
b. phototaxis c. geotaxis d. galvanotaxis

9. Considering the movement of sperm toward the egg during fertilization, evaluate the following statement and select which one is true? a. Sperm movement is completely a mechanical process and dependent on motility mechanism of sperm without the influence of female reproductive path b. Sperms are actively transported by the muscular movement of female genital tract c. Sperm movement is influenced by chemicals released by egg and guiding sperm toward it, called chemotaxis. d. Sperm movement toward the egg is due to the result of positive geotaxis
10. Which type of taxis is also called light compass response……….. a. telotaxis b. mnemotaxis c. menotaxis d. tropotaxis
11. Migration fish which takes place from seawater to fresh water is called…… a. anadromous b. catadromous c. potadromous d. oceanodromous
12. Some fishes such as Anguilla move from river system of Nepal to sea. Which type of migration is this? a. anadromous b. potadromous c. catadromous d. oceanodromous
13. Which of the following birds shows latitudinal migration…….. a. golden plover of USA b. heron c. flycatcher d. pigeon
14. Which of the following is spinal reflex? a. sneezing b. salivation c. knee jerk d. blinking

15. A snail moving on a glass slab when tapped retracts it body within hard shell. But when repeatedly touched it ignores or stop hiding in shell and continues on its way. What type of behaviour is this? a. learnt behaviour
